therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: AKT inhibition + immune checkpoint blockade + microtubule stabilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition + T-cell activation + mitotic disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Participants with locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer

results.effect_size: PFS HR 0.49 (95% CI: 0.28-0.85) for Cohort 1 triple combination vs control; OS HR 1.17 (95% CI: 0.55-2.51)
subgroup_findings: Cohort 1 showed PFS benefit with triple combination (HR 0.49, p=0.0098)
Cohort 2 showed no PFS benefit (HR 0.99, p=0.9809)
No OS benefit observed in any cohort
results.dose_information: Dosage regimens as per arm descriptions (specific doses not provided)

context.comparator: Placebo controls (ipatasertib placebo and/or atezolizumab placebo) + paclitaxel
